# Lionic

> Lionic is a network security company based in Taiwan. It provides in-house Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) engines for licensing and integration, next-generation firewall appliances, and mobile security apps.

Use Licensing pages when integrating security into routers, customer premises equipment (CPE), or embedded devices. Use Products pages when choosing a next-generation firewall (NGFW) appliance or mobile app.
Core capabilities include anti-virus, intrusion prevention (IPS), malicious-URL blocking, Application Visibility & Control (AVC), web content filtering, device fingerprinting, and Quality of Service (QoS).
Internal informational links below point to Markdown versions of the pages. For forms, downloads, or interactive features, open the HTML page identified by the Markdown page's Source URL.
The site is multilingual: English is at `https://www.lionic.com/`, Traditional Chinese at `https://www.lionic.com/zh-tw/`, and Japanese at `https://www.lionic.com/ja-jp/`. Prefer English URLs below unless the user asks for another language; translated Markdown pages use the same path with `/zh-tw` or `/ja-jp` prefixed.
For partnership, pricing, or trials, use Contact. For threat verification, use the Free URL Check service. For site-wide discovery, see the sitemap.

## Licensing Overview

- [Comprehensive DPI Solutions](https://www.lionic.com/licensing/index.md): One-stop DPI licensing overview, integration model, and partner support
- [Network Security Overview](https://www.lionic.com/licensing/network-security/index.md): Licensing hub for Anti-Virus, IPS, and Anti-WebThreat engines
- [AI-Powered Anti-Virus](https://www.lionic.com/licensing/network-security/anti-virus/index.md): Enterprise-grade engine for CPEs, routers, and embedded devices
- [Anti-Intrusion (IPS)](https://www.lionic.com/licensing/network-security/anti-intrusion/index.md): High-performance DPI engine with self-owned threat database
- [Anti-WebThreat](https://www.lionic.com/licensing/network-security/anti-webthreat/index.md): Real-time malicious domain and URL blocking with cloud intelligence
- [Application Visibility & Control](https://www.lionic.com/licensing/behavior-control/application-visibility-and-control/index.md): Identify 1000+ applications with fine-grained control
- [Web Content Filtering](https://www.lionic.com/licensing/behavior-control/web-content-filtering/index.md): HTTPS/QUIC/encrypted-DNS aware categorization and access control
- [Device Fingerprinting](https://www.lionic.com/licensing/behavior-control/device-fingerprinting/index.md): Automatic identification of thousands of device types
- [Quality of Service](https://www.lionic.com/licensing/traffic-management/quality-of-service/index.md): Traffic prioritization and shaping for streaming, gaming, and voice calls
- [Family Safe APP](https://www.lionic.com/licensing/endpoint-solution/family-safe/index.md): Parental-control and endpoint software development kit (SDK) integration example

## Products - Next-Generation Firewall

- [Next-Generation Firewall Overview](https://www.lionic.com/products/next-generation-firewall/index.md): DPI plus AI threat analysis, encrypted-traffic visibility, centralized management
- [Pico-UTM 100](https://www.lionic.com/products/next-generation-firewall/pico-utm-100/index.md): Compact NGFW appliance for small business and edge deployment
- [Tera-UTM 12](https://www.lionic.com/products/next-generation-firewall/tera-utm-12/index.md): High-throughput NGFW appliance
- [Dual Ark-UTM 16](https://www.lionic.com/products/next-generation-firewall/dual-ark-utm-16/index.md): Dual-system NGFW appliance for high availability
- [LionFilter 200](https://www.lionic.com/products/next-generation-firewall/lionfilter-200/index.md): DPI plus AI-scanning appliance with centralized network management
- [Central Management System](https://www.lionic.com/products/next-generation-firewall/central-management-system/index.md): Centralized management for NGFW fleets

## Products - Endpoint Security

- [Lionic Anti-Virus for Android](https://www.lionic.com/products/endpoint-security/anti-virus-android/index.md): On-device Android anti-virus app
- [Lionic Mobile Security for iOS](https://www.lionic.com/products/endpoint-security/anti-virus-ios/index.md): iOS mobile security app
- [Lionic Safe Browsing for Android/iOS](https://www.lionic.com/products/endpoint-security/safe-browsing/index.md): Safe-browsing protection for mobile
- [Lionic Secure QR Code Scanner for Android/iOS](https://www.lionic.com/products/endpoint-security/qr-code-scanner/index.md): QR-code scanning with malicious-URL detection

## Success Stories and Use Cases

- [Licensing Success Stories Overview](https://www.lionic.com/licensing/success-stories/index.md): Index of telecom, SD-WAN, and UTM deployments
- [Telecom Unified Parental Control and Security](https://www.lionic.com/licensing/success-stories/telecom/index.md): U.S. broadband parental-control and security deployment
- [Telecom Solution Provider](https://www.lionic.com/licensing/success-stories/telecom-solution-provider/index.md): Partner deployment for telecom solution providers
- [SD-WAN Solution](https://www.lionic.com/licensing/success-stories/sd-wan-solution/index.md): DPI licensing for software-defined wide area network (SD-WAN) vendors
- [UTM](https://www.lionic.com/licensing/success-stories/utm/index.md): DPI licensing for unified threat management (UTM) vendors
- [Product Success Stories](https://www.lionic.com/products/success-stories/index.md): End-customer NGFW deployment stories

## Company

- [About Us](https://www.lionic.com/company/about/index.md): Company profile, DPI expertise, and partner model
- [Terms of Use](https://www.lionic.com/company/terms-of-use/index.md): Website terms of use
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.lionic.com/company/privacy-policy/index.md): Data collection and privacy practices
- [Security Vulnerability Policy](https://www.lionic.com/company/security-vulnerability-policy/index.md): How to report vulnerabilities

## Support and Resources

- [Downloads](https://www.lionic.com/supports/downloads/index.md): Firmware, software, and documentation downloads
- [FAQ](https://www.lionic.com/supports/faq/index.md): Frequently asked questions, including NGFW setup and licensing
- [Security Advisories](https://www.lionic.com/supports/security-advisories/index.md): Published vulnerability disclosures and fixes
- [Threat Map](https://www.lionic.com/threat-map/): Live visualization of detected threats
- [Contact](https://www.lionic.com/contact/index.md): Business inquiries, partnership, and trial requests
- [Free URL Check Service](https://check.lionic.com/): External tool to check whether a URL is malicious

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://www.lionic.com/sitemap.xml): Full list of indexable pages for discovery
- [News](https://www.lionic.com/news/index.md): Product launches, partnerships, and security updates
- [Careers](https://www.lionic.com/company/careers/index.md): Open positions and hiring information
- [Lionic on YouTube](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCPEWq4yEiyPw06uwBee0sww): Product demos and company videos
- [Lionic on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/lionic/): Company updates and hiring news

AI-Powered Anti-Virus

As cyber threats grow faster and more sophisticated, traditional Anti-Virus solutions often fail to protect the edge of the network, where many attacks begin. Lionic addresses this challenge with an enterprise-grade Anti-Virus engine designed specifically for CPEs, routers, and embedded network devices. Our AI-Powered Anti-Virus module turns your device into a frontline defense system, providing real-time detection and protection against malicious content without affecting performance or system architecture.

Learn More: AI-Powered Anti-Virus

Anti-Intrusion (IPS)

Lionic IPS is designed from the ground up for embedded systems. Unlike oversized engines made for servers, it delivers efficient, real-time threat prevention without exhausting system resources. By inspecting actual payloads instead of just IP addresses, it detects real attacks from malware to brute-force attempts, with smart acceleration and weekly rule updates.

Learn More: Anti-Intrusion (IPS)

Anti-WebThreat

Lionic Anti-WebThreat combines deep packet inspection and AI-driven analysis to block malicious connections across all protocols, not just traditional web traffic. With support for encrypted connections, dynamic cloud queries, and fast local caching, it delivers fast and reliable defense against tens of millions of harmful domains, IPs, and URLs, without relying solely on DNS-level filtering.

Learn More: Anti-WebThreat

Application Visibility & Control

Modern networks require more than just connectivity. They need clarity and control. Lionic’s Application Visibility and Control module provides deep, real-time insight into the applications running across your network without requiring user-side agents or browser plug-ins. Powered by Lionic’s self-owned DPI technology, it identifies over 1,000 applications across Layer 7 traffic, including encrypted and evasive protocols.

Learn More: Application Visibility & Control

Web Content Filtering

Lionic’s Web Content Filtering provides detailed and reliable control over internet access, using deep packet inspection to see what DNS-based tools often miss. With 58 different categories from social media to online shopping, and full support for encrypted traffic like HTTPS, QUIC, and DoH, it enables smarter rules, safer browsing, and cleaner network policies across any environment.

Learn More: Web Content Filtering

Device Fingerprinting

Lionic’s Device Fingerprinting automatically identifies more than 45,000 unique devices from over 1,400 manufacturers, covering everything from PCs and smartphones to webcams, game consoles like PlayStation, air purifiers, Teslas, and even smart mattresses. Using both active probes and passive scans backed by deep packet inspection, it delivers rich details like device type, vendor, model, and OS. A cloud-powered design ensures rapid updates for the latest devices, all without requiring user interaction.

Learn More: Device Fingerprinting

Quality of Service

Lionic’s QoS engine delivers smart traffic prioritization by understanding what the traffic is and who is using it. Powered by deep packet inspection and device awareness, it replaces complex rules with simple category based control that adapts to real world usage.

Learn More: Quality of Service

FamilySafe APP

The FamilySafe app is a flexible reference design that demonstrates Lionic’s full DPI capabilities, including security, behavior control, and traffic management. Designed for families, it offers profile-based settings that link multiple devices to each user, making parental control simple and effective. Available for both Android and iOS, this app can be licensed with source code for seamless integration into your own products and services.

Learn More: FamilySafe APP
